article.headline: Buchanan scores 17, George Washington knocks off Louisiana-Lafayette 83-74
article.description: — Darren Buchanan Jr.'s 17 points helped George Washington defeat Louisiana-Lafayette 83-74 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Buchanan scores 17, George Washington knocks off Louisiana-Lafayette 83-74

categories.description: Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns @ George Washington Revolutionaries

event.description: Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns @ George Washington Revolutionaries

keywords: Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns @ George Washington Revolutionaries
article.story: ST. THOMAS, Virgin Islands -- — Darren Buchanan Jr.'s 17 points helped George Washington defeat Louisiana-Lafayette 83-74 on Saturday night. Buchanan added 10 rebounds for the Revolutionaries (5-1). Trey Autry scored 16 points, going 3 of 5 from the floor, including 3 for 3 from 3-point range, and 7 for 8 from the line. Rafael Castro shot 3 of 3 from the field and 7 for 10 from the line to finish with 13 points. The Ragin' Cajuns (1-5) were led by Mostapha El Moutaouakkil, who recorded 19 points and seven rebounds. Christian Wright added 13 points for Louisiana. Kyran Ratliff also recorded 11 points and six rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
